description: Trusted unlock (credential-protection §5.4): the surface finishes deriving storage_key and opening its sealed Part 1, then asks a vault.unlock challenge for this login's tied device, signs it and sends Part 1 with the signature. The core joins Part 1 to the device's Part 2 from Redis, renews Part 2's TTL, opens the set and holds the unlock on this login, recording the device. Only Part 1 crosses the wire.
